## Session Context (MiDashengLM-Gen Audio)

You have access to unified audio scene generation: speech, music, SFX, and ambience in one 16 kHz mix, generated locally by the MiDashengLM-Gen model.

**Before starting work:**
1. Check model state: audio_scene(operation="status")
2. Browse the library: audio_scene(operation="list", limit=5)

**At end of work:**
- Use audio_scene(operation="export", scene_id=..., destination=...) when the user needs a WAV outside the library
- Offer download_model when status reports model_missing
